review.why: Proofreads a resume or cover letter in five passes without changing the person's facts or voice.
review.summary: Final editorial pass for resumes, CVs and cover letters: facts, clarity, consistency, voice and a last comparison. It returns the clean text plus a short before/after/reason list and questions for factual conflicts. A one-line request gets a one-line edit.
strengths: Five clear passes with a fact-preservation check first
Removes inflated wording without inventing numbers
Reports honestly what a text-only review cannot verify (layout, ATS)
cautions: Text only unless local tools can inspect a PDF or DOCX
Does not match the resume to a job
